title: Italian Bread and Tomato Salad with Cucumber
summary: A rustic vegan panzanella-style salad with juicy tomatoes, crisp cucumber, red onion and fragrant basil. It is bright, tangy and perfect for a simple summer lunch.

ingredients.name: day-old white bread, torn into bite-size pieces

steps: Put the sliced red onion in a small bowl with the red wine vinegar and a pinch of the salt. Leave it to soften for 10 minutes while you prepare the rest of the salad.
If the bread is not very dry, toast the torn pieces in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 4–5 minutes, turning often, until lightly golden at the edges but still a little chewy inside.
Put the chopped tomatoes in a large bowl with the remaining salt and the olive oil. Toss and let them sit for 5 minutes until they release some juices.
Add the cucumber, softened red onion with its vinegar, toasted bread and black pepper to the tomatoes. Toss well so the bread starts soaking up the tomato juices and dressing.
Fold through the torn basil leaves. Rest the salad for 5 minutes, then toss once more and serve while the bread is juicy but still has some texture.
